rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=30, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.001, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=900, seed=42, rationale=iter-12 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: per-scene Adam lr 0.002->0.001 (continue down the lr axis), on the iter-11 NEW CHAMPION base (img_sr=0.0002, n_iter=30, img_kernel=7). BREAKTHROUGH#2 PRIOR: iter-11 (lr 5e-3->2e-3) hr 0.126->0.1835 (+0.057!), PSNR 39.57->40.16, recon_rmse 8.60e-4->8.04e-4 -- CONFIRMED lr=5e-3 was OVERSHOOTING each 30-step per-scene fit toward the noisy 64-view half-target; a gentler lr settles at the edge-preserving denoised-but-sharp optimum. (SSIM dipped 0.9606->0.9537 but hr is RMSE-based and RMSE clearly improved -> real gain.) HYPOTHESIS: the lr axis is monotone-improving so far; lr=1e-3 damps the drift-toward-noise even more, converging tighter to the edge-preserving optimum -> hr climbs above 0.1835. RISK: too-low lr -> the 30-step fit UNDER-converges from the warm-start init (barely denoises) -> recon ~ warm-start-generic, hr regresses. This iter locates the lr optimum: if hr>0.1835 keep lowering (5e-4); if hr<0.1835 the optimum is ~2e-3 and I bracket (1.5e-3). BUDGET: same steps, ~940s, val_n=200. ONE knob: lr 0.002->0.001.
